name: Alert
summary: You are always ready for a fight.

feature.name: Alert
feature.description: You gain the following benefits. Initiative Proficiency: When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap: Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat, unless either of you has the Incapacitated condition.

name: Tough
summary: Your Hit Point maximum grows faster than normal.

feature.name: Tough
feature.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points.

feature.name: Savage Attacker
feature.description: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

prerequisite.text: Repeatable, but you must choose a different spell list each time.

feature.name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
feature.description: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list. You also choose one level 1 spell from that list; you always have it prepared and can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that use on a Long Rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
